<?php
/**
 * Astra Free Lab — presentation styles only.
 */
add_action('wp_head', function () {
    if (is_admin()) return;
    ?>
    <style>
      :root{--lab-ink:#171713;--lab-paper:#f4f0e8;--lab-pine:#1f4d47;--lab-steel:#6f6a62;--lab-rule:#d4cec3}
      body{background:var(--lab-paper);color:var(--lab-ink)}
      .ast-container{max-width:1180px}
      .lab-shell{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto}
      .lab-kicker{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--lab-steel);font-weight:600}
      .lab-hero{padding:clamp(4rem,10vw,8rem) 0 4rem}
      .lab-hero h1{font-size:clamp(3.2rem,8vw,6.6rem);line-height:.93;letter-spacing:-.045em;max-width:10ch;margin:.7rem 0 1.4rem}
      .lab-hero .lead{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2vw,1.35rem);line-height:1.45;max-width:48rem;color:var(--lab-steel)}
      .lab-rule{height:1px;background:var(--lab-rule);margin:3rem 0}
      .lab-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--lab-rule);border:1px solid var(--lab-rule)}
      .lab-card{background:var(--lab-paper);padding:2rem;min-height:230px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;transition:.2s ease}
      .lab-card:hover{background:var(--lab-pine);color:var(--lab-paper)}
      .lab-card h2{font-size:1.8rem;line-height:1.05;margin:1.25rem 0 .65rem}
      .lab-card p{font-size:.94rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(--lab-steel);margin:0}
      .lab-card:hover p{color:rgba(244,240,232,.82)}
      .lab-cta{display:flex;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:2rem}
      .lab-cta a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:48px;padding:0 1.25rem;text-decoration:none}
      .lab-primary{background:var(--lab-pine);color:var(--lab-paper)}
      .lab-secondary{border:1px solid var(--lab-ink);color:var(--lab-ink)}
      .lab-section{padding:4rem 0}
      .lab-section h2{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5vw,4rem);line-height:1;margin:0 0 1rem;letter-spacing:-.03em}
      .lab-section .intro{max-width:48rem;color:var(--lab-steel);line-height:1.6}
      .lab-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3rem;align-items:start}
      .lab-list{border-top:1px solid var(--lab-rule)}
      .lab-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7rem 1fr;gap:1.5rem;padding:1.35rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--lab-rule)}
      .lab-item strong{color:var(--lab-pine)}
      .lab-small{color:var(--lab-steel);font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.55}
      @media(max-width:800px){.lab-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lab-split{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lab-hero h1{max-width:11ch}}

      .lab-architecture{display:grid;gap:0;border-top:1px solid var(--lab-rule)}
      .lab-arch-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(240px,.85fr);gap:2rem;min-height:330px;padding:2.5rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--lab-rule);align-items:center}
      .lab-arch-copy{max-width:620px}
      .lab-arch-copy h3{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:.7rem 0}
      .lab-arch-copy p{max-width:560px;color:var(--lab-steel);line-height:1.6;margin:0}
      .lab-arch-index{color:var(--lab-pine);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
      .holo-stage{position:relative;min-height:280px;display:grid;place-items:center;perspective:900px;overflow:hidden}
      .holo-stage:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:210px;height:210px;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.16);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 45px rgba(31,77,71,.08) inset}
      .holo-axis{position:absolute;width:1px;height:205px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,rgba(31,77,71,.55),transparent);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(31,77,71,.22)}
      .holo-object{position:relative;width:150px;height:150px;transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:holoSpin 15s linear infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(31,77,71,.18))}
      .holo-object:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:8px;border-radius:50%;border:1px dashed rgba(31,77,71,.45);transform:rotateX(70deg);box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(31,77,71,.12)}
      .holo-ring{position:absolute;inset:22px;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.65);border-radius:50%;transform-style:preserve-3d;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(31,77,71,.13)}
      .holo-ring.r2{inset:37px;transform:rotateX(68deg)}
      .holo-ring.r3{inset:13px;transform:rotateX(18deg)}
      .holo-core{position:absolute;inset:54px;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.8);background:rgba(31,77,71,.035);box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(31,77,71,.13),inset 0 0 18px rgba(31,77,71,.08);transform:translateZ(18px)}
      .holo-scan{position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;height:1px;background:rgba(31,77,71,.62);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(31,77,71,.35);animation:holoScan 3.8s ease-in-out infinite}
      .holo-glitch{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.45;mix-blend-mode:multiply;animation:holoGlitch 6.5s steps(1,end) infinite}
      .holo-glitch:before,.holo-glitch:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:18%;right:18%;height:1px;background:rgba(31,77,71,.7)}
      .holo-glitch:before{top:34%}.holo-glitch:after{top:68%}
      .holo--ddd .holo-core{transform:translateZ(22px) rotateZ(45deg);border-radius:3px}
      .holo--ddd .holo-ring.r2{transform:rotateX(72deg) rotateZ(45deg)}
      .holo--backend .holo-ring{border-radius:18%;transform:rotateX(70deg)}
      .holo--backend .holo-core{inset:50px;transform:translateZ(16px);border-radius:7px}
      .holo--backend .holo-ring.r3{transform:rotateX(86deg)}
      .holo--resilience .holo-ring{inset:20px;border-style:dashed}
      .holo--resilience .holo-ring.r2{transform:rotateY(70deg)}
      .holo--resilience .holo-ring.r3{transform:rotateX(70deg) rotateY(25deg)}
      .holo--resilience .holo-core{border-radius:50%;inset:57px}
      .holo--evidence .holo-core{inset:40px 50px;transform:translateZ(24px) rotateY(8deg);border-radius:2px}
      .holo--evidence .holo-ring.r2{transform:rotateX(76deg) rotateZ(90deg)}
      .holo--evidence .holo-ring.r3{transform:rotateY(64deg)}
      @keyframes holoSpin{from{transform:rotateY(0deg) rotateX(4deg)}to{transform:rotateY(360deg) rotateX(4deg)}}
      @keyframes holoScan{0%,100%{top:26%;opacity:.25}50%{top:74%;opacity:.72}}
      @keyframes holoGlitch{0%,87%,100%{transform:none;opacity:.18}88%{transform:translateX(3px) skewX(7deg);opacity:.62}89%{transform:translateX(-2px);opacity:.32}90%{transform:none;opacity:.18}}
      .holo-floor{position:absolute;bottom:18px;width:150px;height:24px;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.22);border-radius:50%;transform:rotateX(68deg);box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(31,77,71,.10)}
      @media(max-width:800px){.lab-arch-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0;padding:2.25rem 0}.holo-stage{min-height:250px;order:2}.lab-arch-copy{order:1}}
      @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.holo-object,.holo-scan,.holo-glitch{animation:none}.holo-object{transform:rotateY(28deg) rotateX(4deg)}}
    </style>
    <?php
});
